reviews_h2: What people are saying about the collision repair

reviews.author: Chase Hebron
reviews.text: Metro Body & Fender are hands down as good as it gets when it comes to doing business. I brought my car in to get my rims repaired from curb rash and the job was done within just a few days. The shop did an outstanding job keeping me updated throughout the whole process and letting me know when my car was ready for pickup. My rims came out looking brand new and the customer service was top tier from start to finish. I highly recommend everyone check out Metro Body & Fender because I promise you won’t regret it. 10/10!!!

reviews.author: Raunak Gulati
reviews.text: My family and I have been going to Metro Body & Fender for years now. We take all of our cars here for any work that needs to be done. Bobby and team are the most professional and the work they do is great. If you need a go-to shop, this is the one.

reviews.author: Charles Nesheiwat
reviews.text: Metro body and fender is the most honest and trustworthy body repair center I've ever worked with. They fixed my car better than new and it didn't even take too long! Will be going back and referring all my friends and family. Thank you!

reviews.author: Claudia Garcia
reviews.text: I wish I could give this establishment a ZERO. WORSE customer service I’ve ever experienced for this line of work. Dropped of car for a simple fender work and it took over a week after being told it will take 2 days, the phone is NEVER answered so every time I needed an update I had to find a ride to go in person. The owner has ZERO respect for women in particular. I wish my husband would’ve never giving you his hard earned money. Please safe yourself the headache and never come here.

reviews.author: Servpro HLF
reviews.text: Took 2 company vehicles here for auto body repair work, Bobby and Josh are phenomenal. Highly recommended, If you want great quality work done right, go to this shop. You’ll have your vehicle back like new in no time.

reviews.author: rushabh doshi
reviews.text: Fixed a Honda CRV bumper, grill, and sensor for me a few months ago. They were very professional and very reasonable, came in lower in cost than 2 other shops. I plan on coming back here in the future.

reviews.author: Nicolas Sanchez
reviews.text: Best shop ever! I travel from out of state PA and won’t take my car anywhere else for anything the car needs. Bobby the owner is a stand up guy and does quality work.

reviews.author: Tonda Hinton
reviews.text: I encourage everyone to take their vehicles here. It’s a small business and they do have a lot of cars but the owner is a genuine and honest guy and he’s not a rip-off unlike several other car repair shops. He’s probably honestly the best mechanic Garfield has to offer. I will keep you updated on everything.

reviews.author: Monique
reviews.text: Very happy with the professional work and with their customer service. Bobby explained the process and most importantly delivered the car as discussed. I had a rocker panel replaced and painted at the shop. Very good paint match! Cant see the difference! I highly recommend their services!

reviews.author: Kallie Georgiadis
reviews.text: Let me just start by saying that Bobby is amazing. He builds up a solid repertoire with all of his customers. My family and I have been faithful customers of his for years and for good reason. He is always trying to do anything to lend a helping hand, always extremely helpful, knowledgeable and kind... and ALWAYS has a smile on his face. The bodywork is always top notch. I've never had an experience with this company where my car hasn't looked completely new and at an extremely reasonable price. I just got my car back today and was floured by how amazing it looked, outside AND inside. If you're looking for a body shop run by honest and empathetic individuals, that will never skimp on excellence... search no further.

reviews.author: Madelyn Romero-Foster
reviews.text: Came here to get my car fixed and they were amazing. The staff are nice, professional, and trustworthy. The pricing is good and honest. I would definitely come here again and highly recommend.

reviews.author: Robyn Sanchez
reviews.text: Bobby Hulass the owner is the best. He does quality work and takes pride in his work. I have been taking my car there for 12 years since I first got my license. I trust him, and I drive to him from an hour away that’s how good he is. He treats me like family And we consider him family.

reviews.author: Isaiah Pickens
reviews.text: After getting into an accident which totaled my car, I waited a year to find the perfect shop to repair my car. The wait was worth it after finding Metro Body and Fender. A friend who uses this shop referred them to me and I’m happy he did. The shop not only repaired my car but also gave me options to upgrade a few things on it. Pulling off the lot in style. Ever since, this is the only shop I use. The communication they give their costumers makes it easy trusting them with my car. When something breaks, I don’t stress over it anymore.. I just call metro and it’s taken care of.

reviews.author: Pierre Aldeus
reviews.text: The entire process from start to completion was excellent. The overall professionalism of this company was outstanding. The work done and time it took to complete was above my expectation. I have recommended Metro Body & Fender to friends and family and would never take my car anywhere else but here.

reviews.author: Jimy Batista
reviews.text: Great shop with transparent approach to your needs. The pricing is good & honest. The guys here are great and trust worthy. Definitely bringing my car again for more services.

reviews.author: John B
reviews.text: Met Bobby by accident 20 years ago and his shop has been a blessing ever since. Excellent work and attitude.

reviews.author: Jenn Perez
reviews.text: I found this business through Instagram. So glad I did!!! I hit a pothole and my car dropped- I immediately thought it was my suspension... towed my car here and was grateful with the job they did. Stepping into an auto business as a woman alone, I was worried they would add a bunch of other unnecessary issues or try to charge me an arm & leg.... I WAS BLESSED....These men looked at my car within a day , educated me that my problem was not as bad as I thought ( I had broken a rim, my suspension was fine) & it was fixed within 3 business days (Original Rim and Wheel had to be ordered). Thankyou Eddie for helping me and not ripping me off! I will def be going back! Work here is professional and pleasant. I rate them a 10 out of 10!!!!

reviews.author: Kevin C
reviews.text: I've been going to Metro for years and will go to no other auto body shop. I highly recommend them. This is the only shop I ever had full confidence in. They do it all from repairs to heavy modifications. Bobby and Josh have an amazing shop and there is nothing they can't do. Thanks for the years of great service.

reviews.author: Robert Linares
reviews.text: So I've brought a few of my cars here. It's the only place I trust. Great attention to detail and easy to work with. I've referred people here and they were also very happy with the service and bragged about the workmanship!

reviews.author: Mohammed Taha
reviews.text: What an amazing experience. Bobby told me that car will be done in one day and sure enough that car was done the very next day. What an amazing job they did. Kudos to Bobby and staff.

reviews.author: Ansara Persad
reviews.text: Bobby and his crew are extremely helpful. They do tremendous work. They are very detailed and efficient. I have recommending them to many of my friends who never leave disappointed!

reviews.author: Jorge Tovar
reviews.text: Any time my cars need body work whether it be a scratch, dent, paint, etc. I bring it to Bobby at Metro Body and Fender. They always do amazing work and I never walk away feeling like they tried to take advantage of me. I always recommend them to my friends.

reviews.author: Chris B
reviews.text: Bought a few parts from here over the past few weeks. Although I’m taking my time to install them they arrived in great time and in good condition. Customer service was patient with many questions. I will be purchasing from them again. Thanks

reviews.author: Lewis Maira
reviews.text: I couldn't say enough great things about this shop. Josh was nice enough to do some research for me and find parts that they had custom fit my vehicle. Extremely neat work and very professional

reviews.author: Moefaanonoa Maiava
reviews.text: I am very happy with the workmanship and professionalism that i have been shown throughout my dealings with this company. Great Place Great People. Just ask for Bobby he will treat you right. Always.

reviews.author: James rodriguez
reviews.text: Been bringing my cars to Metro for 15 yrs. Prices are super reasonable and work is stellar. Bobby is a stand up guy and will treat you right.

reviews.author: Nicole Blanco
reviews.text: They did an amazing job on my Evo x. It's the best shop with great customer service. Thanks Bobby & Josh!

reviews.author: Cuchi Frito
reviews.text: This place is off the hook,Too Good's 5 stars, The work is excellent, the owner/operator is the Man and he obviously leads a big team by example. Feel confident that your experience will be 200%. Keep it up

reviews.author: Dawn Massa
reviews.text: A BIG THANK YOU to Bobby and the guys at Metro Body & Fender... my "baby" looks good as new! Professional/High Quality Workmanship/Fair Prices

reviews.author: Steven Taveras
reviews.text: honestly this is my favorite place to take my car , super good people really good quality. the work speaks for itself i highly recommend 10/10

reviews.author: Juan Gonzalez
reviews.text: These guys do great work and provide excellent customer service! My go to auto body shop and would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Alyssa Pezzetta
reviews.text: Excellent service and turn around time, and fair prices. The work is completely flawless. Plus the owner is very nice.

reviews.author: Jim Trott
reviews.text: Did a great job replacing my front bumper and matching the color to the car. Finished earlier than quoted!

reviews.author: Shaem Ahmed
reviews.text: I had problems with airlift suspension but fixed everything up for me and the price was really good I’d recommend anyone trying to fix or put on airlift products go to them!

reviews.author: Richard Galarza
reviews.text: Heber took care of me with me with my M5 Competition. Him and the rest of the crew were very knowledgeable with my problem and I was also able to get some custom work done.

reviews.author: Lucy Mojica
reviews.text: Amazing service.. time efficient and great prices. Bobby and his staff are always a pleasure doing business with.

reviews.author: amira alberto
reviews.text: Repeated customer! The owner does an amazing job! Great customer experience. I highly recommend this establishment!

reviews.author: The One
reviews.text: Very fair pricing talk to a Salesman over there gave me a great deal planning to take my truck there.

reviews.author: Todd Pankratz
reviews.text: Great to do business with! Very fast service and good communication. Would recommend to anyone. Thanks! Todd

reviews.author: daniel lombard
reviews.text: Ordered a part from Chris through FB, fast communication, ordered it on the 30th, got the part on the 5th, great experience, will recommend!!!

reviews.author: Eddier Rivera
reviews.text: Metro Body & Fender was very professional and helped me throughout the entire process, I would highly recommend them.

reviews.author: Jordan H
reviews.text: Number one stop shop in jersey. They take care of all your needs. Make an appointment and they will take care of you.

reviews.author: Alan Richardson
reviews.text: One of the Best. Great staff, Great work, very professional and personal. They treat you like family

reviews.author: Amalia C Oyarzun
reviews.text: Results above and beyond expectations. I've been a customer for long time now. Great price, great quality.

reviews.author: DNS Automotive
reviews.text: Best body shop in the area, been using Bobby and his staff for years and they have yet to disappoint!

reviews.author: Greg Malek
reviews.text: Customer service may seem a little informal, but I was very pleasantly surprised with the work they did and care they showed. The owner Bobby and his son gave me the same exact estimate independently from one another across two visits. It was a fair and honest price. They did an excellent job repairing my body damage, and finished it a day earlier because I needed it for a vacation departure. They even washed my car, detailed the interior, and polished up some minor scratches unrelated to the damaged area. I will be coming back in the future.
